name: SuperDashboard
desc:
SuperDashboard: a configurable dashboard reached from a floating bubble or the toolbar. Configurable blocks: shortcuts (folders, notes, pdf, ...), a little file browser, name search (with a small query grammar, and optional note-title search), a Contents outline of the current note's headings, recent files, stars, keywords, a clock, device status (battery / free storage / stats), app launchers, Note Clips and To-dos. Several designs and layouts, font (including MyStyle fonts) and text size.

Note Clips: lasso any part of a note and tap "Dashboard Clip" to pin it as a labelled thumbnail; tap it to jump back to its source page, or paste it into any note with a link back to the source. Keep clips as handwriting or OCR them to text (each block shows handwriting, text or both), and paste an OCR'd clip as an editable text box with a font and size of your choice. Underline a word with the straight-line tool and it becomes the clip's label automatically. Backlinks follow the source page even if you reorder it or move it to another note.

To-dos: tap "Dashboard To-do" on a lasso to capture a task; it marks the note with a framed tick-box and a "#N" tag. Tick it in the dashboard and the check is drawn on the note; tick it by hand on the note and, on refresh, the dashboard picks it up (replacing your mark with its own so it can be cleared again). Open/Done tabs, per-note grouping and label filters; if a marked area is cut to another page or note, an on-demand search can find it again.

Contents: an outline of the current note's headings (OCR'd once, cached, and refreshed only for the pages you change); tap a heading to jump to its page. The same index powers note-title search.

Clock: 12/24-hour, optional date, ISO or US week number, several faces (including a 7-segment "Digital" style), and extra time zones you dial in with +/- offsets from local time.

Fully offline (no internet). Needs file access: READ to scan notes for stars/keywords/titles, browse/open files and capture clips; WRITE to save its own settings, to paste a clip into a note, to draw a to-do's tick-box and check, and (only when you turn it on) draw the clip frame on your note. Deleting a star, clip or to-do is always an explicit tap.

Source & updates: https://github.com/AgP42/SuperDashboard; Support the plugin: https://ko-fi.com/agp42
author: AgP42
